Title: Public preview: Azure Database for PostgreSQL – Hyperscale (Citus) support for PostgreSQL 12 and 13

Body.Content:
PostgreSQL 12 and 13 are now supported in preview for Azure Database for PostgreSQL – Hyperscale (Citus). Major enhancements in PostgreSQL 13 include de-duplication of B-tree index entries, increased performance for queries using aggregates or partitioned tables, better query planning when using extended statistics, parallelized vacuuming of indexes, incremental sorting, and more. Major enhancements in PostgreSQL 12 include a variety of performance improvements including support for the SQL/JSON path language, stored general columns, and more.
Currently, Azure Database for PostgreSQL – Hyperscale (Citus) support for PostgreSQL 12 and 13 are available in the East US region only.

Learn more about PostgreSQL 12 and 13.
